svg.metadata: THESIS: Field evidence becomes accountable public work; refuse generic card dashboards and ornamental cinematic effects. OWN-WORLD: Civic Aperture light/night palette, ruled civic docket, one Field Aperture, Signal Cut, Archivo + Source Sans 3 + IBM Plex Mono. STORY: Staff scan live work, verify evidence and location, then take an explicit accountable action. FIRST VIEWPORT: Queue and selected docket are simultaneously legible; evidence, map, provenance, activity, and sticky decisions remain in one frame. FORM: Operate; user-pinned Civic Aperture v0.2; seed key not applicable because the user explicitly approved the generated direction. FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance. APPROVAL: User-pinned approved comp at docs/ui-ux-audit/assets/concept-v2-government-light-dark.png, corroborated by docs/ui-ux-audit/assets/concept-v2-civic-aperture-system.png. EVIDENCE: docs/ui-ux-audit/assets/government-electrical-hazard-generated-v2.png; generated true-color electrical-hazard evidence; a 720 by 540 JPEG transport derivative is embedded identically in both themes for portable Figma display, with the source prompt embedded in its JPEG COM metadata; no color filter, tint, theme treatment, or content edit. BRAND: frontend/public/pulso-logo.png; official existing PULSO raster; its transparent artwork bounds are cropped and resized to 156 by 153 RGBA for portable Figma import, with origin and transformation inside the embedded PNG; the live PULSO wordmark remains editable. TYPE ORIGINS: Archivo, Source Sans 3, and IBM Plex Mono font programs sourced from the official Google Fonts distribution and embedded as glyph-subset WOFF2 for deterministic rendering.
svg.title: PULSO Government Citizen Reports — Civic Aperture Light
svg.desc: Editable 1440 by 900 light-theme government operations screen. A compact role-aware rail, live five-report queue, photographic evidence, sample location map, accountable activity, Signal Cut lifecycle, and sticky decisions share one frame. All demonstration data is visibly labeled sample.
